CharacterDNADesigner.description: Creates the stable base profile before facial structure is generated.

character_name.name: Character name
character_name.tooltip: Stable name used to identify the character.

gender.name: Gender
gender.tooltip: Gender expression included in the base identity prompt.

ancestry.name: Ancestry
ancestry.tooltip: Appearance ancestry included in the base identity prompt.

visual_age.name: Visual age
visual_age.tooltip: The age the character appears to be, from 0 to 120.

identity_appearance.name: Identity appearance
identity_appearance.tooltip: Stable eye color, skin, hair color and identifying marks inherited by every prompt.

CharacterDNAParametricDesigner.description: Overrides one face Feature and inherits every other face value from the input DNA. Chain nodes to edit multiple features.

feature.name: Face feature
feature.tooltip: Select the single facial structural feature to override.

value.name: Value
value.tooltip: Continuous structural coordinate from -1 to +1; 0 is the neutral baseline.

CharacterDNASeedGenerator.description: Deterministically generates 19 facial structural dimensions from seed, distinctiveness, and harmony.

seed.name: Face seed
seed.tooltip: Determines the directions and combination of all 19 face Features; identical inputs reproduce the same face DNA.

distinctiveness.name: Distinctiveness
distinctiveness.tooltip: Controls facial deviation strength and the number of identity focus features; higher values are more pronounced.

harmony.name: Harmony
harmony.tooltip: Controls how strongly conflicting or extreme facial combinations are softened.

CharacterDNACompositeIdentity.description: Combines the 19 face Features into five relational identity descriptions and ranks them by salience.

max_composites.name: Maximum composites
max_composites.tooltip: Keeps the top 1–5 face Composite groups without changing the DNA.

CharacterDNABodySeedGenerator.description: Deterministically generates 20 stable body-proportion dimensions and outputs the complete inherited face/base plus body prompt.

body_seed.name: Body seed
body_seed.tooltip: Identical inputs reproduce the same body DNA.

distinctiveness.name: Distinctiveness
distinctiveness.tooltip: Controls how strongly body proportions depart from neutral.

harmony.name: Harmony
harmony.tooltip: Softens conflicting or implausibly extreme combinations.

CharacterDNAParametricBodyDesigner.description: Overrides one body Feature, inherits all face/base and other body values, and outputs the complete identity prompt. Chain nodes to edit several features.

value.name: Value
value.tooltip: Continuous coordinate from -1 to +1; zero is neutral and produces no body phrase.

CharacterDNABodyCompositeIdentity.description: Turns 20 body Features into up to five natural relational descriptions and combines them with the face identity prompt.

CharacterDNAVisualBlueprint.description: Applies one reusable visual blueprint and a deterministic seed variation to the complete DNA identity prompt. Advanced Look, Performance, Scene and Photography layers are edited in the vocabulary panel.

CharacterDNAInsightFace106Detector.description: Detects InsightFace 106 landmarks and outputs an annotated diagnostic image.

CharacterDNADirectionalCandidateSelector.description: Ranks the analyzed image batch using editable calibrated targets plus within-batch direction, and returns Top N and Pareto image batches.
